name: HYDRA-UMC-DEV-SERVER
technologies: SQLite (durable task/state journal, from DS05 onward)
build: Ten-delivery plan (DS01-DS10, this project's own private development plan): a reproducible development host (target platform: Raspberry Pi 5 or Compute Module 5, both 8GB, NVMe-booted) that hosts this ecosystem's source code, an isolated task/workspace runner for bounded programming/build/test work, and a durable queue coordinating with HYDRA-UMC-OPS-AGENT's own incident lifecycle - never a new AI to train, never a replacement operating system, never itself the authority that decides a machine is safe. Real build: python -m build (see pyproject.toml).
deployment_target_note: "dev-server" is a new deployment_target value, not yet used elsewhere in this ecosystem's manifests (existing values: cm5, mobile, user-pc, wearable). It denotes a Raspberry Pi 5 / CM5 host dedicated to development and task execution - explicitly NOT the same physical role as "cm5" (the operational node that talks to real machines/robots). Documented here so HYDRA-UMC-UPDATER/the dashboard do not misread it as an operational CM5.
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1 - DS01 only ("Contratos, limites y esqueleto verificable") of the 10-delivery plan. This delivery defines who owns which state (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's ownership table, copied verbatim from this project's own private development plan, section 13.2.2), which of that plan's 17 cross-project relationships are necessary/optional/dev-only (docs/OPS_INTEGRATION.md, from that same plan's own section 13.2.1 grouping - not reinterpreted), and a real, tested configuration schema (configs/*.example.json + src/hydra_umc_dev_server/config.py) whose default policy grants NO task deployment permission - verified by test, not just documented. No remote host, workspace runner, task queue, AI provider integration or OPS-AGENT wiring exists yet: those are DS02, DS04, DS05, DS06 and DS07 respectively, each a separate future delivery. inventory.py can discover and validate this ecosystem's own hydra-umc.project.json manifests (including this repository's own), matching the same real, tested pattern HYDRA-UMC-OPS-AGENT's edge role already uses for its own inventory - genuinely real today, not a stub, but it does not yet drive any workspace or task.
